name: Tessera Ambulance Drone
description: A large autonomous medical drone that serves as GLMZ's emergency medical response for Tier 2-4 districts. It arrives in minutes, deploys a stabilization pod around the patient, and flies them to the nearest medical facility. Fast, efficient, and available only to those whose insurance covers it — which excludes most of Tier 1. In the lower tiers, you die on the sidewalk while an Ambulance Drone flies overhead to save someone who can pay. The gap between who lives and who dies in GLMZ is Φ200/month in medical coverage.
capacity: 1 patient in stabilization pod + 2 paramedic passengers
cost: Φ200/month insurance premium for coverage. Uninsured rate: Φ5,000 per transport.
autonomy: Fully autonomous dispatch, remote paramedic oversight
common_usage: Emergency medical transport, trauma response, medical facility transfer.
story_hooks: An Ambulance Drone diverts from its assigned patient to pick up someone in Tier 1 who should have been left to die — and no one authorized the diversion
A hacker discovers they can reroute Ambulance Drones and starts running an underground emergency service for the uninsured
related_entities: Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'
